meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 迁移 OpenClaw 的配置与任务到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想从 OpenClaw 换到 NanoClaw,又不想丢失现有配置。
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2 while keeping your data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from OpenClaw to NanoClaw and want to keep your existing setup.

howto.what: 装上后,它会检测你已有的 OpenClaw 安装,读取身份、频道凭证、群组、定时任务等配置,再和你逐项讨论并确认放置位置后才应用,不会静默复制数据。
howto.when: 当你说 “migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration” 等短语时触发。若默认位置没找到安装,它会询问自定义路径,没有则退出。

say.text: 从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 它会先扫描并汇总检测到的内容

say.text: 导入我 OpenClaw 里的群组和定时任务
say.note: 每部分都先给你确认再应用

say.text: 我的 OpenClaw 装在自定义目录,帮我迁移

howto.what_en: Migrates your OpenClaw install into NanoClaw v2: it detects the existing setup, reads identity, channel credentials, groups and scheduled tasks, then walks you through each area and shows changes before applying. It never copies data silently.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration" or "import from openclaw". If no install is found at the standard locations, it asks for a custom path.

say_en.text: Migrate my OpenClaw setup to NanoClaw v2
say_en.note: It scans first and lists what it found

say_en.text: Import my OpenClaw groups and scheduled tasks
say_en.note: You confirm each area before it applies

say_en.text: My OpenClaw is in a custom directory, migrate it
say_en.note: Lets you pass a non-standard path
